label: Dread gain
summary: Changes by a percentage how much dread the character gains.
details: Dread is a measure of how feared a ruler is. A positive value makes every dread gain larger, a negative one makes it smaller. Works on a character.

label: Dread loss
summary: Changes by a percentage how much dread the character loses.
details: Dread is a measure of how feared a ruler is. A positive value makes dread losses larger, a negative one makes them smaller. Works on a character.

label: Dread per tyranny
summary: Adds a flat amount to the dread the character gains for each point of tyranny.
details: The game calls it 'Dread Gain per Tyranny' and shows one decimal. The input does not explain how tyranny is counted. Works on a character.

label: Dread per tyranny (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the dread gained per point of tyranny.
details: This is the percentage version of the flat 'dread per tyranny' modifier; the game shows both under the same name. Works on a character.

label: House opinion
summary: Changes how much the members of the character's own house like the character.
details: The game shows it as 'House Opinion'. The value is a flat opinion bonus or penalty. Works on a character.

label: Dynasty opinion
summary: Changes how much the members of the character's own dynasty like the character.
details: The game shows it as 'Dynasty Opinion'. The value is a flat opinion bonus or penalty. Works on a character.

label: Elderly health
summary: Changes the character's elderly health, the extra health effect that applies once they are old.
details: The game describes elderly health as the part of health penalties that certain traits (a disease, for example) have on characters above an old-age limit; it stacks with the normal health penalties. The input does not say whether a positive value helps or hurts. Works on a character.

label: Eligible child opinion (not heir)
summary: Going by its name, changes how much the character's eligible children like the character, leaving out a child who is a player's heir.
details: An eligible child is one the law allows to inherit the parent's titles. The game shows the same display name as for the plain eligible child opinion, so the exception rests on the key name only. Works on a character.

label: Eligible child opinion
summary: Changes how much the character's eligible children like the character.
details: An eligible child is one the law allows to inherit the parent's titles; bastards and, under some gender laws, children of a certain gender are not eligible. Works on a character.

label: Embarkation cost
summary: Changes by a percentage what embarkation costs the character.
details: The game shows it with the gold prefix, so the cost is gold. A negative value makes embarking cheaper. Works on a character.

label: Enemy contract scheme phase time
summary: Going by its name, adds days to each phase of contract schemes of the character's enemies.
details: The game shows the value as days per scheme phase. A longer phase makes a scheme progress slower. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy contract scheme success
summary: Going by its name, adds percentage points to the starting success chance of enemy contract schemes.
details: The game labels it 'Initial Enemy contract scheme success chance' and shows the value as already a percentage. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy contract scheme growth
summary: Going by its name, adds to how fast the success chance of enemy contract schemes grows.
details: The game labels it 'Enemy contract scheme Growth' and shows the value as a percentage with one decimal. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy contract scheme max success
summary: Going by its name, adds percentage points to the highest success chance that enemy contract schemes can reach.
details: The game labels it 'Enemy contract scheme Potential'. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy hard casualties
summary: Changes by a percentage the fatal casualties on the enemy side of the character's army.
details: Fatal casualties (dead soldiers) are the soldiers killed or too wounded to fight again, as opposed to routed ones. The game labels it 'Enemy dead soldiers' next to its friendly counterpart, and it is a command modifier: it only counts when the character commands an army. Works on a character and on terrain.

label: Enemy hostile scheme phase time
summary: Going by its name, adds days to each phase of hostile schemes of the character's enemies.
details: The game shows the value as days per scheme phase. A longer phase makes a scheme progress slower. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy hostile scheme success
summary: Going by its name, adds percentage points to the starting success chance of enemy hostile schemes.
details: The game labels it 'Initial Enemy hostile scheme success chance' and shows the value as already a percentage. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy hostile scheme growth
summary: Going by its name, adds to how fast the success chance of enemy hostile schemes grows.
details: The game labels it 'Enemy hostile scheme Growth'. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy hostile scheme max success
summary: Going by its name, adds percentage points to the highest success chance that enemy hostile schemes can reach.
details: The game labels it 'Enemy hostile scheme Potential'. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy personal scheme phase time
summary: Going by its name, adds days to each phase of personal schemes of the character's enemies.
details: The game shows the value as days per scheme phase. A longer phase makes a scheme progress slower. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy personal scheme success
summary: Going by its name, adds percentage points to the starting success chance of enemy personal schemes.
details: The game labels it 'Initial Enemy personal scheme success chance' and shows the value as already a percentage. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy personal scheme growth
summary: Going by its name, adds to how fast the success chance of enemy personal schemes grows.
details: The game labels it 'Enemy personal scheme Growth'. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy personal scheme max success
summary: Going by its name, adds percentage points to the highest success chance that enemy personal schemes can reach.
details: The game labels it 'Enemy personal scheme Potential'. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy political scheme phase time
summary: Going by its name, adds days to each phase of political schemes of the character's enemies.
details: The game shows the value as days per scheme phase. A longer phase makes a scheme progress slower. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy political scheme success
summary: Going by its name, adds percentage points to the starting success chance of enemy political schemes.
details: The game labels it 'Initial Enemy political scheme success chance' and shows the value as already a percentage. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy political scheme growth
summary: Going by its name, adds to how fast the success chance of enemy political schemes grows.
details: The game labels it 'Enemy political scheme Growth'. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy political scheme max success
summary: Going by its name, adds percentage points to the highest success chance that enemy political schemes can reach.
details: The game labels it 'Enemy political scheme Potential'. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy scheme secrecy
summary: Going by its name, adds percentage points to the secrecy of enemy schemes.
details: The game labels it 'Enemy scheme secrecy' and shows the value as already a percentage. Who exactly counts as the enemy is not stated in the input. Works on a character.

label: Enemy defensive advantage
summary: Changes by a percentage the defensive advantage that the enemy gets.
details: The game labels it 'Enemy Defensive advantage' with the command modifier icon, and shows it as a percentage. Works on a character.

label: Epidemic resistance
summary: Changes the epidemic resistance (shown in game as 'plague resistance') of the character, a province or a county.
details: Epidemic resistance lowers the infection rate of a barony or county and so softens the effects of an epidemic; buildings, court physician tasks, decisions and events can raise it. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Epidemic travel danger
summary: Going by its name, changes how dangerous epidemics make travel for the character, a province or a county.
details: The game documents nothing more and gives no display name. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Faith conversion cost
summary: Adds a flat amount to the piety cost of faith conversion.
details: The game labels it 'Faith Conversion Cost' and shows it with the piety prefix. The input does not say whose conversion is meant (the character's own or someone else's). Works on a character.

label: Faith conversion cost (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the piety cost of faith conversion.
details: The percentage version of the flat faith conversion cost; the game shows both under the same name. The input does not say whose conversion is meant. Works on a character.

label: Fellow confederation member opinion
summary: Changes how much the other members of the character's confederation like the character.
details: The value is a flat opinion bonus or penalty. Works on a character.

label: Fellow tributary opinion
summary: Changes how much the character's fellow tributaries like the character.
details: The value is a flat opinion bonus or penalty. Works on a character.

label: Fellow vassal opinion
summary: Changes how much the character's fellow vassals, those under the same liege, like the character.
details: The value is a flat opinion bonus or penalty. Works on a character.

label: Fertility
summary: Changes the character's fertility, which measures how able they are to have children.
details: The game shows it as a percentage. Works on a character.

label: Fort level
summary: Changes the fort level of fortified holdings.
details: The fort level of a fortified holding decides how long a siege against it is expected to last; a high level needs siege weapons to besiege efficiently. The input does not say which holdings a character-level value reaches. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Garrison size
summary: Changes by a percentage the size of the garrison of fortified holdings.
details: The garrison protects a fortified holding: a besieging army needs more soldiers than the garrison for the siege to progress. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: General opinion
summary: Changes how much everyone likes the character.
details: The value is a flat opinion bonus or penalty. Works on a character.

label: Genetic trait strengthen chance
summary: Changes by a percentage the chance of reinforcing congenital traits.
details: The game labels it 'Chance of reinforcing congenital traits'. The input does not say whether this is about the character's children or the character. Works on a character.

label: Great project build speed
summary: Changes by a percentage how fast great projects are built.
details: The game's name for this concept is 'Great Project Construction Time'; the format shows a time prefix and a percentage. The input does not say whose projects are meant. Works on a character.

label: Guest opinion
summary: Changes how much guests like the character.
details: The game shows it as 'Guest Opinion'; the value is a flat opinion bonus or penalty. Works on a character.

label: Vassal barter goods contribution
summary: Adds a flat monthly amount of barter goods contributed by happy powerful vassals who are councillors.
details: Barter goods are the trade wares used by rulers of the wanua government. The value is shown as a monthly amount with one decimal. Works on a character.

label: Vassal barter goods contribution (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the barter goods contributed by happy powerful vassals who are councillors.
details: The game's 'contribution' is the amount a vassal's obligation really pays; a percentage raises or lowers that amount. Works on a character.

label: Vassal herd contribution
summary: Adds to the base contribution of herd from happy powerful vassals who are councillors.
details: Base contribution is a percentage of the vassal's own total income of that resource that they pay; the format shows this modifier as a percentage. Works on a character.

label: Vassal herd contribution (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the herd contributed by happy powerful vassals who are councillors.
details: The game's 'contribution' is the amount a vassal's obligation really pays; a percentage raises or lowers that amount. Works on a character.

label: Vassal levy contribution
summary: Adds to the base contribution of levy from happy powerful vassals who are councillors.
details: Base contribution is a percentage of the vassal's own total of that resource that they pay; the format shows this modifier as a percentage with a soldier icon. Works on a character.

label: Vassal levy contribution (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the levy contributed by happy powerful vassals who are councillors.
details: The game's 'contribution' is the amount a vassal's obligation really pays; a percentage raises or lowers that amount. Works on a character.

label: Vassal piety contribution
summary: Adds to the base contribution of piety from happy powerful vassals who are councillors.
details: Base contribution is a percentage of the vassal's own total income of that resource that they pay; the format shows this modifier as a percentage. Works on a character.

label: Vassal piety contribution (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the piety contributed by happy powerful vassals who are councillors.
details: The game's 'contribution' is the amount a vassal's obligation really pays; a percentage raises or lowers that amount. Works on a character.

label: Vassal prestige contribution
summary: Adds to the base contribution of prestige from happy powerful vassals who are councillors.
details: Base contribution is a percentage of the vassal's own total income of that resource that they pay; the format shows this modifier as a percentage. Works on a character.

label: Vassal prestige contribution (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the prestige contributed by happy powerful vassals who are councillors.
details: The game's 'contribution' is the amount a vassal's obligation really pays; a percentage raises or lowers that amount. Works on a character.

label: Vassal tax contribution
summary: Adds to the base contribution of tax from happy powerful vassals who are councillors.
details: Base contribution is a percentage of the vassal's own total income that they pay; for example +10% on a vassal with 10 gold income who pays 1 makes them pay 2. The format shows this modifier as a percentage. Works on a character.

label: Vassal tax contribution (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the tax contributed by happy powerful vassals who are councillors.
details: The game's 'contribution' is the amount a vassal's obligation really pays; for example +10% on a vassal who pays 1 gold makes them pay 1.1. Works on a character.

label: Friendly hard casualties
summary: Changes by a percentage the fatal casualties on the character's own side.
details: Fatal casualties (dead soldiers) are the soldiers killed or too wounded to fight again, as opposed to routed ones. The game labels it 'Friendly dead soldiers' and it is a command modifier: it only counts when the character commands an army. Works on a character and on terrain.

label: Winter dead soldiers
summary: Changes by a percentage the fatal casualties in provinces that are affected by winter.
details: The game labels it 'Dead soldiers in Provinces affected by Winter'. Fatal casualties are the soldiers killed or too wounded to fight again. Works on a province.

label: Health
summary: Changes the character's health.
details: Health measures how likely a character is to die from illness and old age. Works on a character.

label: Herd capacity
summary: Adds a flat amount to how much herd the character can hold.
details: The game shows it as 'Herd Capacity'. Works on a character.

label: Herd capacity (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage how much herd the character can hold.
details: The percentage version of the flat herd capacity; the game shows both under the same name. Works on a character.

label: Herd conversion
summary: Changes by a percentage how well herd is converted into nomadic riders.
details: The game labels it 'Herd Conversion into nomadic riders' and shows one decimal. Works on a character.

label: Herd gain
summary: Changes by a percentage how much herd the character gains.
details: The game takes its display name from a separate herd gain text. Works on a character.

label: Holding gold cost
summary: Going by its name, changes by a percentage the gold cost of building holdings.
details: The game gives no display name; its format shows a gold prefix and a percentage, with a higher value counted as bad. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Holding piety cost
summary: Going by its name, changes by a percentage the piety cost of building holdings.
details: The game gives no display name; its format shows a piety prefix and a percentage, with a higher value counted as bad. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Holding prestige cost
summary: Going by its name, changes by a percentage the prestige cost of building holdings.
details: The game gives no display name; its format shows a prestige prefix and a percentage, with a higher value counted as bad. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Holding build speed
summary: Going by its name, changes by a percentage how fast holdings are built.
details: The game gives no display name; its format shows a time prefix and a percentage. Vanilla court positions and council tasks use it with small values such as -0.02 or -7. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Holy order hire cost
summary: Adds a flat amount to the cost of hiring a military holy order.
details: The game labels it 'Military Holy Order Hire Cost'. Its format shows a piety prefix, so the input does not settle which resource the amount is in. Works on a character.

label: Holy order hire cost (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the cost of hiring a military holy order.
details: The percentage version of the flat hire cost; the game shows both under the same name. Works on a character.

label: Horde regiment upgrade cost
summary: Changes by a percentage the gold cost of upgrading a horde regiment.
details: The game labels it 'Upgrade horde Regiment Cost'; the format shows a gold prefix, with a higher value counted as bad. Works on a character.

label: Hostage income
summary: Changes by a percentage the income the character gets each month from hostages.
details: The game labels it 'Monthly income from hostages'. Works on a character.

label: Hostage piety
summary: Changes by a percentage the piety the character gets each month from hostages.
details: Works on a character.

label: Hostage prestige
summary: Changes by a percentage the prestige the character gets each month from hostages.
details: Works on a character.

label: Hostage renown
summary: Changes by a percentage the dynasty prestige (renown) the character gets each month from hostages.
details: The game labels it 'Monthly dynasty prestige from hostages'. Works on a character.

label: Hostile county attrition
summary: Changes by a percentage the attrition (troop losses) that the character's armies suffer in hostile counties.
details: The format counts a higher value as bad, so a negative value protects the army. Works on a character.

label: Raiding county attrition
summary: Changes by a percentage the attrition that the character's armies suffer in hostile counties while raiding.
details: The format counts a higher value as bad, so a negative value protects the army. Works on a character.

label: Hostile raid time
summary: Changes by a percentage how long a hostile raid takes.
details: The game labels it 'Hostile Raid Time'. The input does not say whose raids are meant (the character's own or ones against them). Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Hostile scheme speed
summary: Adds days to each phase of the character's hostile schemes.
details: The game shows the value as days per scheme phase. A shorter phase makes a scheme progress faster, so a negative value speeds hostile schemes up. Works on a character.

label: House relation change
summary: Changes by a percentage how much house relations change.
details: A house relation is the standing between two houses that builds up from their interactions and lasts over the generations. The game labels this 'Change to house relation'. The input does not say which houses are meant. Works on a character.

label: Ignore different faith opinion
summary: Makes the character ignore the opinion effect of having a different faith.
details: It is a switch: vanilla traits write it as `yes`. The game's second text for the effect reads 'No Negative Opinion of Other Faiths', so it is the negative opinion that is ignored. Works on a character.

label: Ignore negative culture opinion
summary: Makes the character ignore the negative opinion that culture differences cause.
details: It is a switch: vanilla traits and house powers write it as `yes`. Works on a character.
